appearance.extreme: Their skin is a visible lattice of vessels, radiating heat off them in the cold air. They shiver constantly and don't seem to notice.
appearance.obvious: A dense web of surface veins runs up their arms and throat, and they're cold to be near.
appearance.subtle: Their skin is unusually cool, and the veins at their wrists sit close to the surface.

description: Your vasculature reorganised itself for dumping heat. Summer stopped being a problem. Winter became one.
name: Heat-Shedding Skin
